name: Arcane Background (Gifted)
description: Some lucky sods just wake up one day with powers that don’t neatly fit into any of the usual flashy categories. Could be low-key super abilities, a dodgy divine hand-me-down, or something properly alien. Either way, it’s all a bit eccentric and doesn’t play by the normal rules — which, let’s be honest, makes it rather more interesting.
summary: Innate oddball powers that don’t fit magic, miracles or psionics. Unusual and unique.

name: Arcane Background (Magic)
description: From pompous archmages to dodgy cultists in basements, magicians yank raw supernatural energy out of the ether and hurl it about with dramatic gestures and ancient-sounding nonsense. The stuff is everywhere if you know how to poke it properly.
summary: Classic spell-slingers who channel raw supernatural energy through words, gestures, and runes.

name: Arcane Background (Miracles)
description: These pious types beg favours from gods, nature spirits, or whatever divine bureaucracy will listen. A quick prayer or dusty ritual usually does the trick. They’re often saddled with inconvenient vows and might have a few mates in the same holy club who can lend a hand when the divine tap runs dry.
summary: Divine champions who call upon gods or spirits through prayer and ritual. Often bound by vows.

name: Arcane Background (Psionics)
description: Brainy sorts who poke reality directly with the power of their massive ego — sorry, mind. They read thoughts, bend spoons, and occasionally cause headaches for government agencies. Some trained for years; others just woke up weird one Tuesday.
summary: Mentalists who wield raw brainpower to manipulate matter and minds.

name: Arcane Background (Weird Science)
description: Mad inventors cobble together ridiculous contraptions that shouldn’t work but somehow do, thanks to exotic fuels, alien scrap, or sheer bloody-minded genius. Their gadgets are highly personal — good luck getting anyone else to make the damn things function without exploding. The “magic” lives in the inventor, not the gadget.
summary: Eccentric inventors whose bizarre gadgets channel strange powers. Devices are personal and often temperamental.
